rationale: Pulp's standalone Development Inspector needs an explicit deterministic-capture capability so an SSH client never infers safe in-process pixels from permission-gated compositor capture. WindowHost therefore gains one conservative append-only query for capture_back_buffer_png support; the standalone adapter prefers that live back buffer and otherwise delegates to the shared capture_view Skia/GPU/provider path. The capture-primitives slice gains the shared tree-requirements query and decoder-independent PNG validation needed to keep CLI and runtime capability claims honest across backends. Missing producers, malformed PNGs, and native-overlay trees fail closed. This is Pulp-specific developer-tool and standalone-host integration work with no counterpart framework behavior to backport.
